about.headline: Built on the ground, since 2014.
about.body: Toolègba is a pan-African BTL group, active across six West and Central African markets since 2014 — known as Hoope Africa until our 2025 rebrand. We started from a simple observation: classic mass media has shown its limits. Real impact comes from direct contact with the consumer. That's the strategy we've spent over a decade refining, backed by a team with 15+ years of combined experience in major ATL, BTL and TTL agencies.

craft.headline: Every campaign starts with real contact.

difference.headline: Why It Matters for Your Brand
difference.body: A campaign is not a deliverable, it's contact with real people. It's the difference between an activation nobody remembers and one that moves your market.

market.title: 12+ Years Learning Your Market
market.text: We've walked the points of sale in Cotonou, Abidjan and beyond since 2014. Local teams, local languages, real knowledge of how people actually shop and move — not a slide deck.

team.title: One Team, Trained Local Resources
team.text: In every country we operate, we rely on resources who know the local ecosystem — and we train and supervise them directly. No brief lost in translation.

scoping.title: Honest Scoping. Not Overselling.
scoping.text: Sometimes the answer is one well-placed activation. Sometimes it's a full distribution network build. We'll tell you which — we won't sell you mass media we don't believe still works.

impact.title: Impact We Measure After the Fact
impact.text: Daily, weekly and monthly reports, tracked through our own field app. You see exactly what moved — agents recruited, POS deployed, visits made — not just what looked good on launch day.

industries.headline: Trusted Across Key Sectors
industries.body: From telecom to banking to insurance, the sectors where trade marketing and distribution execution matter most.

realisationsSection.headline: Selected work, across six countries.
realisationsSection.body: Real results for real clients — MTN, Ecobank and more — from Cotonou to Dakar.

realisationsPage.headline: Six campaigns. Six different markets.
realisationsPage.body: Every market has its own codes. Discover the strategy and on-the-ground execution behind results we can put a number on.

benin.title: Ecobank Benin, Merchant Network
benin.description: A long-standing Toolègba client, Ecobank Benin entrusted us with animating its distribution network. Our results on this contract earned Ecobank's trust in Togo, Guinea and Senegal too.

cotedivoire.title: MTN Ivory Coast, Mobile Money Network
cotedivoire.description: Deployment and animation of MTN Ivory Coast's Mobile Money agent and merchant network, using the same model already proven elsewhere on the continent.

cameroun.title: Field Presence, Cameroon
cameroun.description: Our local team in Cameroon applies the same direct-consumer-contact approach that's built our reputation across the six countries where we operate.

guinee.title: Ecobank Guinea, Trade Marketing Rollout
guinee.description: Following our results in Benin, Ecobank entrusted us with animating its network in Guinea too, using the same method and execution standards.

togo.title: Ecobank Togo, Trade Marketing Rollout
togo.description: The same trusted contract renewed in Togo: field animation and distribution network development for Ecobank.

senegal.title: Mobile Money Network, Senegal
senegal.description: In three and a half years, we grew this network from 2,000 to 26,000 active agents and from 300 to 18,000 accepting merchants, creating more than 53,000 points of convergence along the way.

hero.headline: On a mission to become Africa's biggest BTL agency.
hero.body: Toolègba has run BTL campaigns across Africa since 2014 — as Hoope Africa until our 2025 rebrand. Today, under the Toolègba name, we help partners hit their KPIs through trade marketing and event-driven actions, backed by owned logistics, trained local teams, and financial partnerships that let us commit fully to every campaign.

values.headline: What Drives Us
values.body: Three principles, non-negotiable on every campaign.

items.title: Rigor
items.text: Every campaign follows a precise framework: clear objectives, tracked execution, nothing left to chance.

items.title: Discipline
items.text: Constant field presence, backed by daily tracking and reporting tools.

items.title: Results
items.text: We commit to KPIs, not promises. That's what we report back.

services.headline: Five Disciplines, One Team on the Ground
services.body: From trade marketing to distribution, every function your brand needs to move product and build presence.

space.headline: Where It All Comes Together
space.body: Our studio in Cotonou, where strategies take shape before heading to the field, across the six countries where we operate.

team.headline: Small Team, Big Ambition
team.body: A multidisciplinary team of strategists, creatives and field specialists who genuinely love what they build.

hero.headline: Let's talk about your next campaign.
hero.body: Tell us about your project. No pressure, just a conversation about what's possible.

form.headline: Tell us about your project
form.consent: I agree that this information will only be used to respond to my request.
form.note: We respond within 24 hours · No spam, ever
form.thanksBody: Your message has been received. We'll get back to you within 24 hours.

items.a: A team member will contact you within 24 hours to understand your needs and plan a first conversation, by phone or at the agency.

items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: A one-off activation can launch within a few weeks. A full distribution network build usually takes six to twelve weeks, from strategy to reporting.
Every quote details the proposed strategy, deliverables, timeline and media or field costs, with no hidden fees.

items.q: Do you work with small businesses?
items.a: Yes. We scale the scope to your budget, whether it's a local activation or a regional campaign across our six markets.
